items.html:
Flavian Aponso was one of the Netherlands players aged over 40 who formed the mainstay of their batting for some time. He batted high in the order, sometimes as opener, and he was a useful bowler, mainly of offspin. He hails from Sri Lanka originally, but moved to Holland after being banned for taking part in the 1982-83 rebel tour of South Africa. Aponso quit his international career after the 1996 World Cup.
Wisden Cricinfo staff
October 2004
